svg.data-weight: 16.1 lb (7.3 kg) with the 320 W AC supply (datasheet); 16-18 lb (7.2-8.2 kg) with one supply (guide Table 3)
svg.data-weight-chassis-parts: 320 W AC and 190 W DC supplies 2.5 lb (1.1 kg); 600 W and 930 W AC supplies 3.1 lb (1.4 kg) (guide Table 3)
svg.data-depth-with-large-psu: 489 mm (19.25 in, 48.9 cm) with a 600 W or 930 W AC supply (guide Table 3); 18.8 in (47.8 cm) in the datasheet
svg.data-datasheet-dimensions: 17.41 x 1.72 x 16.43 in (44.21 x 4.32 x 41.73 cm) W x H x D; the guide's Table 3 is used for the envelope
svg.data-width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in, 48.2 cm) with the mounting brackets attached
svg.data-switching-capacity: 88 Gbps packet switching, 216 Gbps aggregate, 64-byte packets (datasheet)
svg.data-psu-redundancy: one supply carries a fully loaded chassis; a second gives redundancy (datasheet)
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 50.8 dBA with the 320 W AC supply (datasheet, ISO 7779 at 23 C)
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing operating; 0 to 95 percent non-operating
svg.data-altitude: up to 3049 m operating (10,000 ft); 4877 m non-operating
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 members over the 128 Gbps backplane; two rear Virtual Chassis ports, and the SFP network ports can be configured as VCPs
svg.data-uplink-module: one slot; EX-UM-4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP, EX-UM-2X4SFP-M or EX-UM-2XFP (not part of the shipping configuration)
svg.data-optics-sfp: 100BASE-FX (EX-SFP-1FE-FX, -LX, -BX), 1000BASE-X (SX, LX, LH, BX, CWDM) and 1000BASE-T copper SFP (EX-SFP-1GE-T) (datasheet ordering information)
svg.data-oob: RJ-45 management port on the rear, 100 Mbps full duplex, with link/activity and status lamps
svg.data-lcd: 2 lines of 16 characters with Menu and Enter buttons
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear
svg.data-nebs: NEBS certified (datasheet Table 1 and compliance section)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, ICES-003, VCCI Class A
